# CS Executive Services, LLC

> Boutique, principal-led executive services firm based in Arlington County, Virginia, serving the Washington, DC metropolitan area. Founded by a United States Marine Corps veteran. Four practice areas: executive chauffeur transportation, automotive detailing, brand strategy and positioning, and IT security advisory. All engagements are private, by correspondence — the firm does not publish rates or availability.

Confidentiality is a condition of practice, not a feature: no client names, engagement details, or identifying information appear in any public material.

## Practice areas

- [Executive Chauffeur](https://csexecutiveservices.com/services/chauffeur.html): Private ground transportation across the DC metro area (DCA, IAD, BWI, corporate and residential). Operates as a chauffeur brokerage matching clients with vetted professionals; select engagements conducted directly by the principal.
- [Automotive Detailing](https://csexecutiveservices.com/services/detailing.html): Individualized vehicle care, no standardized package.
- [Brand Strategy](https://csexecutiveservices.com/services/brand-strategy.html): Identity, positioning, and narrative counsel for founders and senior leaders.
- [IT Security](https://csexecutiveservices.com/services/it-security.html): Privacy-first security advisory — posture, policy, practical counsel.

## About

- [About the Firm](https://csexecutiveservices.com/about.html): Founder Corey Sheldon, USMC veteran, principal-led structure, privacy commitment.
